message.plain:
List runs in the store, newest activity last. Filters narrow what is printed; with none, every run is listed

Usage: salvor list [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --status <STATUS>  Keep only runs with this status. Repeatable; a run matching ANY of them is kept. Values are the labels the STATUS column prints. To filter by a whole group of states instead, use `--group` [possible values: not-started, running, awaiting-model, awaiting-tool, suspended, sleeping, budget-exceeded, needs-reconciliation, completed, failed, abandoned]
      --store <PATH>     Path to the SQLite event store [env: SALVOR_STORE=] [default: ./salvor.db]
      --group <GROUP>    Keep only runs in this group: `waiting` (needs a person), `progress` (moving on its own), or `terminal` (finished, one way or another). These are the same three groups the status colours use. To filter by a single state instead, use `--status` [possible values: waiting, progress, terminal]
      --agent <TEXT>     Keep only runs whose agent identity contains this text: a definition hash, or `graph run` for a graph
      --limit <N>        Print at most N runs, keeping the most recently active ones. The order on screen is unchanged, so the newest still sit at the bottom
  -h, --help             Print help (see more with '--help')
